description: Navigates the user's Frapea tab to a project so they can WATCH the edit live. Not required for editing — every tool works headlessly; use this for show-your-work moments. This reloads the Frapea tab, so an export or render running there stops.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: open_project
title: Open project in the editor
